title: viburnum sargentii f. lutescens
intro: Viburnum sargentii f. lutescens, commonly known as Sargent's Viburnum or Golden Chastetree, is a deciduous shrub native to China, characterized by its golden-yellow foliage and clusters of small white flowers. The plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues, due to its potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Viburnum sargentii f. lutescens are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
